title: Invert Binary Tree
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, invert the tree by swapping the left and right children of every node. This transforms the tree so that if you view it from a mirror perspective, you get the original tree structure.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 100]

visibleExamples.explanation: The tree is inverted by swapping children at each node.
A simple tree with root 2, left child 1, right child 3 is inverted.

jsonFriendlyReason: The input and output parameters are TreeNode pointers, which require a custom tree adapter and cannot be directly represented as JSON literals.
